run_browse_dataset: run the browse_dataset tool to visualize detection bboxes and masks for a dataset using a config file
run_browse_dataset_save_output: run the browse_dataset tool with --output-dir to save annotated images to a directory instead of displaying
run_browse_dataset_no_show: run the browse_dataset tool with --not-show to skip display and only save output images
run_browse_dataset_skip_pipeline: run the browse_dataset tool with --skip-type to exclude specific pipeline steps like Normalize or Collect
run_browse_dataset_custom_interval: run the browse_dataset tool with --show-interval to set the display wait time between images
